slides.title: Spoken Tutorial on Building a Marketing Slogan Creator
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on Building a Marketing Slogan Creator.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to,

• Get your **Gemini API** key.
• Use the **Gemini API** with **Python**.
• Generate marketing slogans using **Python**.
• Modify topics to create new slogans.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration:
To follow along, you will need a web browser.
Also, a Google account and access to **Google Colab**.

slides.title: Pre-requisites
slides.narration: To follow this tutorial, you should have watched Episode 1 and 2 of this module.

slides.title: What is an API Key? Your Digital Passport
slides.narration:
What if you need to enter a restricted area?
**API** keys are like a digital passport.
They grant your application access to a specific service.
The key tells the service who is making the request.
This ensures secure and authorized communication.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration showing API key as a digital passport for secure access

slides.title: From Idea to AI: A Vague Request
slides.narration:
What if you want **AI** to create marketing slogans for you?
Imagine asking a person for slogans.
You might say, 'Give me some slogans for sneakers'.
This is a vague request, but a human can understand it.
Now, let's see how we make this clear for **AI**.
slides.image_prompt: Person scratching head, confused at screen, trying to give vague instructions to AI

slides.title: Improved Request: Crafting the Gemini Prompt
slides.narration:
To get precise **AI** results, we need a clear **prompt**.
In **Python**, we first define our product.
Then we craft a specific **prompt**.
For example: 'Create 5 catchy marketing slogans for eco-friendly sneakers'.
Notice how specific the request is.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user typing 'Create 5 catchy marketing slogans for eco-friendly sneakers...'

slides.title: Comparison: Human vs. AI Instruction
slides.narration:
A human can understand a vague request.
But **AI** needs explicit instructions.
Our **Python** code translates your idea into a structured **prompt**.
This **prompt** goes to the **Gemini API**.
This ensures clear communication and relevant output.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side: vague human request vs explicit AI prompt

slides.title: Running Your Slogan Creator and Exploring Ideas
slides.narration:
Your **API** key and code are now ready.
**Run** the **Colab** notebook.
See how it generates slogans.
You can change the 'product_topic' variable.
Try 'spicy hot sauce' or 'productivity app'.
Explore different ideas with ease.
slides.image_prompt: Person at laptop, smiling at the screen showing AI-generated slogans for different topics

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we learned.
You learned to get a **Gemini API** key.
We wrote **Python** code to use the **Gemini API**.
Finally, we built a marketing slogan generator.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Here is an assignment for you.
Change the product topic in the code.
Generate slogans for your own product idea.
Compare the results.
